content: Radix UI AlertDialog (or shadcn built on Radix) is the popular 2025 pattern for confirmation dialogs, but it is a new dependency the project doesn't have. The native HTML <dialog> element with showModal() is Baseline widely-available since March 2022 (~96% global browser support), gives automatic focus trap, aria-modal, and inert background for free, and needs zero new npm dependency — just a useRef+useEffect wrapper component. This fits the project's constraint of not introducing a new heavy dependency for WEB confirmation dialogs on destructive admin actions.
